title: Illustration use / Maritime scenes beside text

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Keep a text column stable while varying the image side so related pages can feel coherent without repeating the same composition.
strategic_value: Maritime fragments on yellow can give Helsinki copy a lively local context while retaining readable hierarchy.
demonstration: Waterfront and boat illustrations occupy the left; a heading and two paragraphs sit in a right-hand column on yellow.
practical_value: Reverse the illustration/text balance when a sequence needs variation, keeping a clear column for reading.
